description: A pet drinks liquid, including sustained lapping from a container.
A pet eats food, including taking food into its mouth and chewing.
A pet mouths, carries, paws at, or tugs a surgical face mask.
A pet bites, chews, or pulls furniture or its upholstery with its mouth.
A dog barks repeatedly in an audible bout. Label bouts rather than each individual bark.
A dog stands or balances upright on its hind legs, with both front paws off the ground.
